title: MAFIA: Multi-Adapter Fused Inclusive LanguAge Models
reasoning: The paper identifies 'religion' as one of its four primary bias dimensions to evaluate and mitigate. It specifically generates a dataset for religion-bias evaluation (Religion-Bias sentence pairs), utilizes Wikidata properties related to faith and religious entities (e.g., 'worshipped by', 'religion or worldview', 'deity'), and includes extensive lists of religious terms and faith traditions in the appendix for the purpose of debiasing and benchmarking.
